editorial:
Imagine being a kid who finds out that the scary stories your grandma told you about witches are actually true. You follow a young boy who moves to Alabama to live with his wonderful grandmother, only to discover that witches are real and they absolutely hate children. The vibe is a mix of spooky and silly, making it a great pick for a family movie night. It feels like a wild ride from the start, blending a cozy family bond with the shock of finding out that some fancy ladies in wigs are actually monsters in disguise.

Anne Hathaway totally steals the show as the Grand High Witch because she is both scary and hilarious. The special effects are top-notch, and the pace keeps you moving without feeling too slow. While some parts might be a bit too creepy for very small kids, most viewers will love the humor and the heart. If you want the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the weird details, or you could rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch. Adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is also a smart move if you love owning high-quality family films.
endingExplained: After the boy and his grandma team up with other kids who were turned into mice, they sneak into the hotel ballroom. They trick the Grand High Witch into taking a potion that turns her and all her followers into mice too. Once the witches are tiny, they are chased away or eaten. The boy stays a mouse, but he is happy because he gets to live a long, secret life with his grandma.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves magical adventures and quirky stories.
